thread:
anya (PM): Heads-up: two customers want incremental JSON streaming + a deterministic way to know when it's safe to call tools. Quick design huddle.

sam (eng): We should avoid assuming clients can parse partial JSON. Envelope per delta is safest: seq, more, ctype, payload. Clients concat payloads until more:false.

luca (eng-rt): Runtime can emit events: delta(struct), delta(text), control(finish_reason). Recommend finish_reason set: stop, function_call, function_stream, cancel, timeout, fallback, incomplete.

marie (research): Clarify function_stream: means function args are streaming and not yet complete; function_call means the model finished and provided full args/result.

nora (devex): SDKs must hide reassembly. Provide events: onPartialStructured, onStructuredComplete(reassembledVerified), onFunctionReady(meta,args), onFinish(reason). Default autoInvokeFunctions:false.

sam (eng): Telemetry/ops gate: reassembly_error_rate < 0.2% on canary. Also track unverified_invocation attempts. Launch block if >0 on pilot orgs.

anya (PM): MVP MUST: envelope schema v1 documented, SSE streaming + envelope, JS+Python helpers, telemetry gates, org opt-in for auto-invoke. SHOULD: WS multiplexing. WANT: server-side auto-invoke for approved customers.

ops-bot: Canary started: feature/stream-struct-contract at 2025-06-01T09:00:00Z.

anya (PM): Action items: Sam/luca produce runtime contract; Nora sketch SDK API; Marie produce finish_reason table. Sync Friday.

sam (eng): :thumbsup:
